title: commersonia rugosa
intro: Commersonia rugosa, commonly known as the Queensland hibiscus or hibiscus pear, is a plant species native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Commersonia rugosa include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
